description: Na₄Mg(MoO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic F222 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.86 Å. Mg is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.24 Å) and four longer (2.64 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Mo-O bond lengths are 1.87 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Mo-O bond lengths are 1.87 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom.
